one_month_reasoning: The window contains TI's Q3-2026 report and Q4 guide (expected ~Tue Oct 20-21, 2026, following TI's usual third-Tuesday-of-October pattern; date not yet confirmed in my sources), the ex-dividend date Oct 30 ($1.52, ~0.5%, negligible), and a possible MOFCOM determination/extension on the US analog-chip antidumping case (original deadline 2026-09-13, extendable 6 months). Industry evidence argues for a beat on the Q3 guide midpoint ($5.9B / $2.40): ADI guided +7% q/q with price increases not yet in results, TI's July 1 price hikes and retroactive enforcement on open POs, and lengthening TI lead times. But the stock is +63% y/y, the beat is widely expected, and TI's Q4 guide is typically seasonal-to-below; a guide that implies the cycle is peaking or a China duty headline can drive a -8 to -12% day. Net: a small positive drift (median ~$296) with monthly sigma ~12.5% (42%/3.5, slightly widened for earnings).

fair_value.method: Blend of 24x CY2028 EPS $11.0 (consensus $11.60 less 5% peak-cycle haircut) = $264 (60%) and 17x CY2028 EBITDA $15.05B less net debt = $276 (40%); multiples set against a 9-name analog/power peer set on calendar-2027 street EPS (median 22.2x P/E, 15.3x EV/EBITDA).

methods.inputs: CY2028 consensus EPS $11.60 haircut 5% for peak-cycle risk = $11.0 x 24x (NTM multiple applied at Oct-2027)

Trade-press evidence of panic buying (300% premiums, retroactive price hikes, 52+wk lead times) is a classic late-cycle double-ordering signal; WSTS sees analog growth slowing to 6.6% in 2027, below the ~14% revenue growth embedded in TXN 2027 consensus

Peer median CY27 P/E 22.2x (9 peers, range 13.4x-47.8x); ADI, the closest analog peer, 24.9x. 24x = modest premium to median for TXN's higher gross margin/ownership of 300mm capacity, below ADI given TXN's slower 2027 EPS growth (+19% vs ADI +27%)

methods.inputs: CY2028 EBITDA $15.05B x 17x = EV $255.9B, less 2028E net debt $4.16B, / 913.2M shares

bear.story: Shortage-driven double ordering unwinds in H2-2027 (classic analog cycle: lead times 52+ wks, 300% spot premiums in Sept-2026 trade press), distributor inventories rebuild, pricing reverses; China imposes antidumping duties on TI interface/gate-driver ICs. CY2028 EPS ~$9 x 20x.

base.story: Upcycle continues through mid-2027 with price increases sticking; growth decelerates toward WSTS's +6.6% analog 2027 forecast; consensus CY2027 EPS ~$10.1 delivered, CY2028 ~$11; multiple compresses from 29x to ~25x as the market looks through peak margins.

bull.story: TI's owned 300mm capacity wins share while ADI and others are capacity-constrained (60-70 wk lead times), data-center power keeps doubling, capex falls to ~$3B so FCF/share exceeds $12; CY2028 EPS $13+ at ~28x.

comps_summary.peer_range: CY2027 P/E 13.4x (NXPI) to 47.8x (MPWR); EV/EBITDA 10.5x (NXPI) to 32.9x (MPWR). Basis: calendar-2027 street EPS (non-GAAP where the company reports it: ADI, NXPI, ON, MCHP; MarketScreener consensus for STM, IFX, Renesas, MPWR, POWI). ADI FY Oct-27 calendarized +2 months; IFX 0.75xFY Sep-27 + 0.25xFY Sep-28; MCHP 0.25xFY Mar-27 + 0.75xFY Mar-28 (FY28 non-GAAP estimated by scaling FY27 $3.65 by consensus EBITDA growth +16.6%). EV/EBITDA uses CY27 EBITDA and latest net debt; STM and Renesas lacked EBITDA data. SLAB and ALGM were excluded because their consensus is GAAP-loss/near-zero, which makes P/E meaningless; only 9 genuine comparables had usable data.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: TXN trades at 29.1x CY2027 EPS ($293.8 / $10.10) and ~19.8x CY2027 EV/EBITDA, above the medians and in line with or above ADI. Our valuation uses 24x P/E and 17x EV/EBITDA on CY2028, inside the peer range and slightly above the median.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: A small premium over the median (not the current ~30%) is defensible: TXN owns its 300mm analog capacity, so it can supply into a shortage that peers serve from foundries/limited fabs (trade press: ADI lead times 60-70 wks vs TI enforcing price rather than allocation-only), and its capex is falling from ~$4.5B to ~$2.6-2.9B, lifting FCF from $2.6B (2025) to ~$9.8B (2027E). Against that, TXN's 2027 EPS growth (+19%) is below ADI (+27%), ON (+42%) and the trough-recovery names, and it is the most exposed name to the China antidumping case, so no premium over ADI is justified.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$205 the market would be pricing CY2028 EPS near $8.5-9 at a ~23x multiple, i.e. the 2026-27 upcycle reversing into a double-ordering correction or a material China duty on TI analog parts; that is a fundamental break, not normal 42%-vol noise (a ~1-sigma down move from the base lands near $205-210 only if the base case is wrong).

key_uncertainties: Whether Sept-2026 shortage signals (retroactive price enforcement, 300% spot premiums, 60-70wk peer lead times) mark a 2027 peak and double-ordering unwind
Durability of TI's 2026 price increases (10%-85%) once capacity catches up
China antidumping duty on TI interface/gate-driver ICs and share loss to Chinese analog vendors
Multiple compression from ~29x if growth slows to WSTS's 6.6% analog 2027 forecast
reasoning: Industry evidence is unambiguously strong for the next few quarters: ADI posted +40% y/y with industrial +53%, guided up again and flagged price increases not yet in results; WSTS sees analog +10% in 2026; trade press (Fusion Greensheet Jul/Sep 2026) reports TI price hikes of 10-85% from July 1, retroactive enforcement on open POs, extending TPS/SN74 lead times and customers paying 300%+ premiums. TXN itself guided Q3 above seasonal with 2026 consensus EPS ~$8.5 (+52%) and 2027 $10.1. The flip side is that these are textbook late-cycle signals in analog (2018, 2022 precedents): panic buying and double orders that unwind into inventory corrections; WSTS expects analog growth to slow to 6.6% in 2027, and China's antidumping probe targets TI's commodity interface/gate-driver lines. On a consistent calendar-2027 street-EPS basis, 9 peers trade at a 22.2x median (15.3x EV/EBITDA); TXN at 29.1x is near the top. Valuing CY2028 at 24x P/E and 17x EV/EBITDA gives ~$270, below the $294 price and the $325 consensus target. Scenarios: bear $180 (25%), base $285 (50%), bull $380 (25%), mean ~$283. The ladder is a lognormal around a ~$282 median with sigma ~0.36 (a bit below the 42% realized vol because part of that came from the 2025 trough rally), with a slightly fatter left tail for cycle-reversal and China duty risk. Research limits: Alpha Vantage and Twelve Data estimate endpoints were unavailable, and Yahoo analysis pages failed for several peers, so peer EPS for STM/IFX/Renesas/MPWR/POWI come from MarketScreener consensus, and MCHP FY28 was estimated.
